## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit/negative tests pass
- [ ] Static security policy analysis passes
- [ ] No secret or credential is included
- [ ] External data remains treated as untrusted
- [ ] New GitHub Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs
- [ ] Workflow permissions follow least privilege
- [ ] Security/privacy impact was considered

## Security impact

Describe any change to trust boundaries, network access, generated artifacts, browser behavior, or CI/CD permissions. Use "None" only when genuinely not applicable.
